text: Could you change the red body paint on the red hatchback in this attached pic to navy blue? I’ve been wondering what it would look like in a different colour, so that’s why I’m asking. Please keep the original wide framing and 16:9 aspect ratio; free-tier resolution is fine. I’d like the original paint finish and reflections retained when you change the colour. Leave everything else in the photo unchanged, with no other edits or added text. I’m a little nervous about whether I’ll like the navy, but I’m curious to see it.
